A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the current STTT algorithm is robust and performs well in the laboratory diagnosis of Lyme disease, and that MTTT algorithms are a reasonable alternative.
, although the STTT algorithms are robust, there is a need for a more sensitive and cost-effective diagnostic test for early Lyme disease.
